source.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 Configuring firewalls and packet filters
source.applicability: RHEL 9 firewall configuration using firewalld and nftables

passages.text: firewalld uses the concepts of zones, policies, and services to simplify traffic management. Zones logically separate a network. Network interfaces and sources can be assigned to a zone. Policies are used to deny or allow traffic flowing between zones.

4. Intrazone traffic (within the same zone) is allowed by default.

           5. Interzone traffic (from zone to zone) is denied by default.
